notes.title: Galaxy Cannon Rider is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Enjoy this action filled sidescroller full of powerups and challenges! Buy the game today for 15% off, but hurry, its only for the first week of release!

About the game:

Join the circus and travel around the galaxy! Create your team among 50+ different heroes and jump from cannon to cannon, from trampoline to trampoline, and several others obstacles. Collect coins, stars, tickets and other power ups! Unlock all seven different worlds in this addictive physics game. Collect coins to buy characters in the store which each have an own special power like a ballon or a teleporter!

FEATURES:
- recruit 50+ heroes with individual powers
- play in seven different worlds with their own look and feel
- get items and power-ups to jump further
- complete objectives to get more coins
